review_candidates.title: IT Specialist (SaaS Systems & Support)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will work closely with our IT Manager in Amsterdam and our Senior IT Support Specialist in Cairo to resolve support requests, improve IT processes, maintain documentation, support compliance activities, and help keep our IT environment reliable and secure. Troubleshoot hardware, software, account access, SaaS, network, and endpoint issues. Administer and maintain our internal tools, including Google Workspace and other business applications. Maintain IT documentation, user guides, asset reco
eligibility_evidence: This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical support, solving user problems, improving processes, and working in an international environment.
🌍 International Team: join a diverse crew with 10+ nationalities.
🏡 Hybrid Work Model: flexibility to work remotely.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We collaborate with surgical professionals and teams worldwide, sharing expertise through our award-winning e-learning platform, featuring 2D & 3D modules, augmented reality, and virtual reality applications. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical support, solving user problems, improving processes, and working in an international environment. What You Bring 💪 At least 2 years of experience in an IT support, service desk, or technical support role. Nice To Have Familiarity with ISO 27001 requirements or similar security/compliance frameworks. 💰 Competitive Salary: get rewarded for your skills and expertise.
